title: Unknown type
why: A data-quality edge: the passenger type is Unknown even though an age is known. It shows whether the code accepts the combination, flags it, or wrongly infers a type from the age.

steps.does: Fetch the passenger by Id and list passengers filtered to type Unknown.

expect: The passenger is returned with PassengerType Unknown and Age 34 unchanged. The type is not auto-derived from the age, and the record appears in the Unknown filter and not in the Male, Female or Baby filters.
